title: Emitter transition function
statement: Define the machine’s one-step transition as follows. In a reading state, it uses the current phase and input symbol to decide whether to halt, advance the phase, mark a work tape, or begin emitting the gate’s Tseitin clauses. In an emission state, it processes the next instruction in the gate’s clause program: output instructions emit their Boolean value, while print instructions move the indicated work-tape head through the write and boundary-check states; when the program ends, the machine clears the designated work-tape cells and advances to the gate-reading phase. The cleanup and increment states perform those respective tape actions and return to reading the gate phase.
hypotheses_covered: current state is one of the defined emitter states
work-tape symbols are given for each of the three tapes
caveat: This summary describes the transition’s phases, but does not enumerate every branch condition and state update in the definition.
